amp.headerSubtitle: A single-ended, high-performance headphone amplifier — fully SMD on a 4-layer PCB, with a hybrid JFET + TPA6120 topology and a symmetrical battery power supply.
amp.aboutP1: NyaaHibiV2 builds on the topology of the first-generation amplifier, -NyaaHibi-. The name NyaaHibi itself comes from Japanese: Nyaa (にゃあ), meaning a cat's meow, and Hibi (日々), meaning every day. Combined, NyaaHibi can be read as "meowing every day" — a simple philosophy of bringing enjoyable sound that can be savored every day ^_^.
amp.aboutP2: In version V2, the design is fully SMD with several improvements — most notably, the final stage now uses the TPA6120A2 IC. The PCB is also upgraded to 4 layers for cleaner routing and lower noise. The circuit topology has been refined as well, improving sound quality while keeping the amplifier stable.
amp.topologyAlt: Block diagram of the NyaaHibiV2 amplifier

ampBlocks.title: Discrete JFET Input
ampBlocks.desc: Used to reduce the shortcomings of SMD input capacitors — the design is fully SMD, so large film capacitors like Wima aren't an option. JFETs also give a more "tube-ish" character, as their transfer curve resembles a vacuum tube.

ampBlocks.title: BJT Current Booster
ampBlocks.desc: Because a JFET's current capability is limited, BJT transistors are added as a current boost so the following stage can operate optimally.

ampBlocks.title: Outer Loop Preamp Gain
ampBlocks.desc: The main voltage gain stage of the system — it largely determines the amplifier's character or tonal color.

ampBlocks.title: Inner Loop Nested Feedback
ampBlocks.desc: Keeps the circuit stable despite the high gain of the preamp gain stage, minimizing phase shift.

ampBlocks.title: Buffer Frontend
ampBlocks.desc: Isolates the preamp gain block from the final stage so they don't affect each other.

ampBlocks.title: Front End Final Stage
ampBlocks.desc: Uses a composite amplifier concept to help correct the signal before it reaches the final output stage.

ampBlocks.title: Final Stage (TPA6120)
ampBlocks.desc: Uses the TPA6120 IC, known for its high slew rate, wide bandwidth, and excellent performance in headphone amplifier applications.

ampBlocks.title: DC Servo
ampBlocks.desc: Used because the design omits a DC blocking capacitor in the signal path. The DC servo keeps the output DC offset low without affecting the sound character.

amp.psuAlt: Block diagram of the NyaaHibiV2 power supply

psuBlocks.title: Charger Module
psuBlocks.desc: Uses a TP4056 module mounted onboard to save PCB space.

psuBlocks.title: Active Bypass Charging
psuBlocks.desc: While the battery charges, the amplifier draws power directly from the charger. This keeps the charging module from being overloaded when the amplifier is on. Switching uses a MOSFET to reduce power loss compared with conventional diodes.

psuBlocks.title: Step-Up Converter
psuBlocks.desc: Raises the battery voltage, with high- and low-voltage modes. Low mode gives longer runtime, while high mode delivers maximum performance.

psuBlocks.title: Charge Pump
psuBlocks.desc: Generates a negative voltage rail so the power supply becomes symmetrical (+ and −).

psuBlocks.title: Filter Stage 1
psuBlocks.desc: A combination of capacitor, ferrite bead, resistor, and capacitor that dampens initial ripple and noise.

psuBlocks.title: Capacitance Multiplier
psuBlocks.desc: Makes a small SMD capacitance behave like a large one, keeping the supply cleaner.

psuBlocks.title: Filter Stage 2
psuBlocks.desc: A local filter placed near each IC to reduce noise picked up from long supply traces.
